resources.string: How Holistic uses your health data

Holistic Health Connect reads your Health Connect records (steps, heart rate, resting heart rate, sleep, active calories, distance, exercise sessions, SpO2 and HRV where available) and syncs them to your Holistic Health Optimization Platform account. Data is sent only to the server you pair with, over HTTPS, and is never sold or shared. You can disconnect at any time from the website, which also deletes the readings that were synced.
